title: winy nostalgic crisp british chickpea bowl
description: a classic british dish with a twist, featuring sashimi-cut chickpeas in a wine-infused broth, served in a crispy dolsot stone bowl

ingredients.name: dolsot stone bowl
ingredients.notes: any type of stone bowl will do, but dolsot is traditional in korean cuisine

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar
ingredients.notes: you can substitute with apple cider vinegar or lemon juice if you prefer

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality extra virgin olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: dried thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh thyme is also delicious, but dried is more traditional

ingredients.name: chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: for garnish only, feel free to omit if you don't like parsley

instructions: heat the olive oil in the dolsot stone bowl over medium heat
add the white wine vinegar, thyme, salt, and pepper to the bowl
stir to combine and bring to a simmer
add the canned chickpeas to the bowl and stir to coat with the wine sauce
cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the chickpeas are heated through
taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately
